verdict.rationale: Ente's documented CLI only exports and decrypts Auth data for backup. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI command or API that returns a current TOTP code to an agent. Generating codes from exported secrets with an external tool is a user-side workaround built on a developer building block, and the enteauth://search deep link only opens in-app search, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
